description: This file defines the SugarTab class, which manages the rendering and setup of tabbed navigation in the SuiteCRM interface, including handling tab visibility, preferences, and rendering through Smarty templates.

classes.name: SugarTab
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the logic for setting up, rendering, and displaying a tabbed interface in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tab type and Smarty template engine.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the tab data, including handling the max tab preferences, selected group, and submenu titles, and assigns data to Smarty for rendering.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the HTML output for the tab interface from the Smarty template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the HTML for the tab interface directly.
